$comment: Rhythm / position / compliance rules JSON Schema cannot express. Each rule id here must exist in schema/semantic_validate.py RULES with the same severity (extraction/verify_all.py checks this).

rules.description: A PageSpec's nodes must match its declared template's node list in order, honouring required/repeatable, keyed on (section, variant).
rules.exception: Single template; every node required, non-repeatable.

rules.description: No (section, variant) pair may appear twice.
rules.exception: Every section is onePerPage in the current contracts; the keying on (section, variant) is kept so a future section with several variants stays valid.

rules.description: shell.nav must be the first node.
hero.course-intro must immediately follow shell.nav.
cta.waitlist-form must immediately precede shell.footer-wordmark.
shell.footer-wordmark must immediately precede layer.webgl-object.
layer.webgl-object must be the last node (the canvas sits after the page wrapper).
Every CTA href is '#signup' and a cta.waitlist-form node with anchorId 'signup' must exist.
Every footer siteNav href must resolve to an anchorId present in the page.
Anchor ids should be unique; the documented source duplicate 'cta' (content.block-pairs/feature-pairs and cta.pitch-timeline/default) is a warning, any other duplicate is an error.
Any segment with layer behind-canvas / behind-canvas-deep requires a layer.webgl-object node.
At most one behind-canvas segment per display heading, at most 3 behind-canvas list items, at most 2 behind-canvas wordmark words (observed maxima).
A node's motion.patterns must be a subset of its (section, variant) contract's allowedPatterns; page motion limited to page-level patterns.
Every node and the page carry the reducedMotionFallback fixed by their contract.
rules.exception: Fallbacks are design-repo policy: the source has no reduced-motion handling (mv.motion.no-reduced-motion).

rules.description: Every budgeted text field respects its section contract's maxWords (words = whitespace tokens after stripping ** and __).
Every assetRef.assetRole is a role in assets/asset-roles.json.
assetRef.source must be allowed by its role's generationPolicy; ref prefix must match the source.
No assetRef.ref may contain a real asset filename, host, endpoint or tracking id from the original (refDenylist).
Compliance-critical roles must carry their pinned generationPolicy (checked against a hard-coded table in the validator, not just enum membership).
A PageSpec with contentProvenance 'generated' may not contain the real brand or author identity in any text (brandTextDenylist).
rules.exception: contentProvenance 'evidence-reference' (the bundled example) may carry real copy for reference only and must never be published as the real brand.

rules.description: There is no marquee section: marquee CSS exists on the source with no DOM. Section ids are a closed set without one.

Every sections/*.json satisfies schema/section-contract.schema.json (closed: no unknown fields; semantic and source are separate closed objects; retrievalEligible is a boolean and a false value requires a 30+ character retrievalReason).
semantic.id equals the contract id, semantic.category equals the id prefix and the pinned table in the validator; a section missing from the pinned table is an error until reviewed.
A section with submit/action/timeline content fields must be category cta; a cta or priceNote field may not live in a generic content or list section.

Utility/runtime UI (cookie/consent, modal, dialog, overlay, toast, decorative fixed layer) must set retrievalEligible false with a retrievalReason of 30+ characters; every other section must be true. Checked against a pinned table, not just the schema.
source.lines is a valid 'a-b' range, source.id equals every variant anchorId, and no two sections claim the same source range. verify_all.py checks the range against the real file.
